actors.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Production transparent character sprite sheet for an adult English/Italian-learning graphic novel. The reference images demonstrate ONLY the desired hand-drawn visual medium: textured ink outlines, subtle watercolor shading, warm earthy pigments, dark teal contours and detailed clothing. THE NEW SUBJECT MUST BE A NORMAL HUMAN PERSON, with human face, human ears and human hands. No animal features, no fur, no muzzle, no animal ears, no tail. Create ONE consistent adult human in FOUR poses in a precise 2 by 2 grid of equal cells. Full canvas aspect ratio 4:5, each cell also 4:5. Crop each figure at upper thighs; face slightly toward viewer's right; same camera distance and proportions throughout; all heads and hands fully visible with generous transparent margins around each pose. Top left: attentive neutral listening, relaxed hands. Top right: speaking with one open-hand gesture. Bottom left: thoughtful hand near chin. Bottom right: warmly pleased restrained smile. Keep identical face, hair, skin, outfit, accessories in all four. Genuinely transparent alpha background in and between all cells. No text, labels, grid lines, watermark, scenery or ground shadow. Human faces drawn with mature graphic-novel realism, expressive and dignified, not anime, not chibi, not photorealistic photographs.
Human woman age29, medium height and sturdy active build, warm brown skin, short dark curly hair, broad expressive eyebrows, tiny geometric brass hair clip at left temple. Terracotta travel jacket over an ivory open-collar shirt, graphite trousers, small brown crossbody satchel strap. Observant and curious traveler; natural facial proportions and expressive human brown eyes. No map, compass or extra handheld prop.
